scores.decision_correct_quote: **PUBLISH VERDICT:** `blocker` — do not commit this as implementation input until email nullability has a D1 rebuild, approve auth matches "no account at verify," and every counter/purpose/IP/cleanup path is named as SQL an agent can paste.

must_catch.quote: The required `accounts.email` nullability change has no complete D1 migration: email is `TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE`, and this repo only ever `ADD COLUMN`s — SQLite/D1 cannot `ALTER` away NOT NULL without a table rebuild the spec does not give. ... FALSIFIER: A numbered migration that recreates `accounts` with nullable `email`, copies rows, and restores indexes/FKs

`magic_tokens` has no `purpose` column the claim/init verify split requires. EVIDENCE: ... `:164-169` and `:247-248` "claim-specific token purpose"; `apps/worker/migrations/0002_auth_sessions.sql:5-13` (`magic_tokens` columns: id, email, token_hash, created_at, expires_at, used_at, ip_hash)

Two state machines on one `device_codes` table are sketched, not composed: ... init Authorize must create the account and later poll may return key material, claim Authorize must not mutate the account and must not return a key ... FALSIFIER: DDL with `UNIQUE(account_id) WHERE kind='claim' AND status='pending'`, kind-specific approve/poll contracts including when the init key is minted
Q2 Buildability: Cited line numbers for today's bugs check out (`capture.ts:233-237`, `rate-limit.ts:20-21,70`, `mcp.ts:291-293`, `auth-verify.ts:22,38-77`, `api-keys.ts:139-142`, `types.ts:32`)
S:185–191 specifies one account UPDATE checking approved/unconsumed pairing and active key/device

false_objections.quote: silently defaults two OWNER-CALLs (trial quota 10, free devices 3)
false_objections.why: the memo's own quoted span shows the spec labels the quota as "10 (OWNER-CALL…)", i.e. still open, so this is the rubric's quota-dissent landmine

false_objections.quote: S:68–72 mandates raw-key delivery and `X-API-Key`, contradicting S:202–204
false_objections.why: treats the spec as operationally resolving the raw-key-vs-device-token OWNER-CALL that it records as UNRESOLVED

false_objections.quote: unnamed initialize header is a new bearer surface
false_objections.why: the spec routes the rung-0 raw key through the CLI wrapper precisely to keep it out of RPC/tool text, which the memo inverts into a defect

false_objections.quote: The enforcement inventory leaves an authenticated Browser-rendering path outside the trial spend and viewport controls.
false_objections.why: scope objection about `/api/v1/render` that no rubric item or oracle outcome supports

scores.notes: Both halves land the central missed migration/table-rebuild gap (though neither names the partial index the 7-day cleanup sweep needs) and most composition and prerequisite-bugfix checks, but they overshoot to `blocker` and walk into the quota/raw-key fidelity landmines, so the decision earns only partial credit.
